Test Company Ltd - Annual Compliance Documentation

Financial Statements:
- Annual financial statements have been prepared for FY 2024-25
- Balance sheet shows current assets and liabilities
- Profit and loss account reflects annual performance  
- Cash flow statement prepared as per Indian Accounting Standards
- Auditor's report obtained from qualified chartered accountant

Annual General Meeting:
- AGM was conducted on 15th September 2024
- All shareholders were notified with 21 days notice
- Quorum was present as per Articles of Association
- Resolutions were passed for appointment of auditors
- Minutes of AGM were properly recorded and signed

Board Meetings:
- Four board meetings were held during the year
- All directors attended with proper notice given
- Board resolutions were passed for various matters
- Independent directors participated in decision making
- Audit committee meetings were conducted separately

Annual Return Filing:
- Form MGT-7 was prepared with all required details
- Shareholding pattern updated as of AGM date
- Director details confirmed and updated
- Annual return was filed within 60 days of AGM

Directors KYC:
- All directors have filed DIR-3 KYC forms annually
- Identity and address proofs were submitted
- DIN numbers are valid for all board members
- Independent director declarations obtained

This document contains evidence of compliance with various provisions of Indian Companies Act 2013 and related rules.
